reportedIssues: The pizza card shows a '-0%' discount badge. A 0% discount is meaningless, looks like a data or template bug, and misleads users into expecting a deal.

The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', the '(500+)' rating count) is light gray on white and likely has low contrast. The white time pills over the light Green Bowl Poké image also blend into the background.
The heart/favorite button on the pizza card has a dark translucent background that differs from the ramen card's heart button, which has almost no visible background. The two look inconsistent.
The promo banner has decorative circles that overlap the right edge and are cropped awkwardly. The white 'Order now' button on the green banner also looks slightly detached from the text.
